mapper.sql: u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.email_addr, u.user_stat_cd, u.mod_dttm, u.last_login_dttm

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE r WHERE r.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id=#{roleCd})
AND (u.user_nm LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR u.user_id LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM TB_SY_USER u ORDER BY u.user_nm, u.user_id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT r.role_id FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE r WHERE r.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.role_id
SELECT r.role_nm FROM TB_SY_ROLE r JOIN TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur ON ur.role_id=r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT names.part_nm FROM ( SELECT p.part_nm FROM TB_BS_PART p JOIN TB_BS_PART_STD s ON s.part_id=p.part_id WHERE s.part_ldr_user_id=#{id} AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYYMM') AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYYMM')) UNION SELECT p.part_nm FROM TB_BS_PART p JOIN TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s ON s.part_id=p.part_id WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' AND p.hq_yn='Y' ) names ORDER BY names.part_nm

SELECT DISTINCT p.part_nm FROM TB_BS_PART p JOIN TB_BS_PART_STD s ON s.part_id=p.part_id WHERE s.part_ldr_user_id=#{id} AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYYMM')) ORDER BY p.part_nm
SELECT p.part_id FROM TB_BS_PART p WHERE p.hq_yn='Y' AND p.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY p.part_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s JOIN TB_BS_PART p ON p.part_id=s.part_id WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' AND p.hq_yn='Y')
SELECT DISTINCT p.proj_id, p.proj_nm FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p JOIN TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s ON s.proj_id=p.proj_id WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' ORDER BY p.proj_nm, p.proj_id

SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id, p.proj_id, p.proj_nm FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.proj_id=s.proj_id JOIN TB_SY_USER_ROLE r ON r.user_id=s.user_id AND r.role_id='PM' WHERE s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND s.user_id != #{id} AND s.proj_id IN #{project} ORDER BY s.user_id, p.proj_id
SELECT count(*) FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE r WHERE r.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id='ADMIN')

SELECT l.act_dttm, COALESCE(c.code_nm,l.act_type_cd) AS action, COALESCE(l.trgt_desc,'') AS trgt_desc FROM TB_SY_ACCS_LOG l LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.code_grp_id='ACT_TYPE' AND c.code=l.act_type_cd WHERE l.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY l.act_dttm DESC, l.log_id DESC LIMIT #{filter.pageSize} OFFSET #{filter.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM TB_SY_ACCS_LOG l WHERE l.user_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: mod_user_id='admin', mod_dttm=GREATEST(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', mod_dttm + INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_USER (user_id,user_nm,email_addr,pwd_hash,temp_pwd_yn,pwd_err_cnt,user_stat_cd, mfa_use_yn,mfa_err_cnt,reg_user_id,reg_dttm,mod_user_id,mod_dttm) VALUES (#{input.userId},#{input.name},#{input.email},#{hash},'Y',0,'USE','N',0,'admin', clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','admin',clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET WHERE user_id=#{id} AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{token,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET pwd_hash=#{hash},temp_pwd_yn='Y', WHERE user_id=#{id} AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{token,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_USER_ROLE (user_id,role_id,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES (#{id},#{role},'admin',clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE WHERE user_id=#{id} AND scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND proj_id=#{project}
DELETE FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s USING TB_BS_PART p WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' AND s.part_id=p.part_id AND p.hq_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_USER_SCOPE (user_id,scope_sn,scope_type_cd,part_id,proj_id,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) SELECT #{id}, COALESCE(MAX(s.scope_sn),0)+1, #{type}, #{value},NULLNULL,#{value}, 'admin',clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s WHERE s.user_id=#{id}

INSERT INTO TB_SY_ACCS_LOG (user_id,act_type_cd,scrn_id,trgt_desc,act_dttm,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES (#{id},#{action},'UI-23',#{target},clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','admin',clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

INSERT INTO TB_SY_CHG_HIST (trgt_tbl_nm,trgt_key,chg_type_cd,chg_item_nm,bfr_val,aft_val,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES (#{table},#{key},#{type},#{item},#{before,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'admin',clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
